question: There are 3 containers of equal capacity and all are completely filled with a mixture of acid and water. The ratio of acid and water in the three containers is 1 ∶ 4, 3 ∶ 7 and 2 ∶ 3, respectively. If the contents of all the 3 containers are mixed together, what is the ratio of acid to water in the mixture?
solution: Given: There are 3 containers of equal capacity and all are completely filled with a mixture of acid and water. The ratio of acid and water in the three containers is 1 ∶ 4, 3 ∶ 7 and 2 ∶ 3, respectively. Calculation: Let the capacity of each container be 100x. Quantity of acid in the first container = 100x × 1/(1 + 4) = 20x Quantity of acid in the second container = 100x × 3/(3 + 7) = 30x Quantity of acid in the third container = 100x × 2/(2 + 3) = 40x Total quantity of acid = 20x + 30x + 40x ⇒ 90x Quantity of water in the first container = 100x × 4/(1 + 4) = 80x Quantity of water in the second container = 100x × 7/(3 + 7) = 70x Quantity of water in the third container = 100x × 3/(2 + 3) = 60x Total quantity of water = 80x + 70x + 60x ⇒ 210x Now, the required ratio of the acid to the water = 90x : 210x ⇒ 3 : 7 **∴ The ratio of acid to water in the mixture is 3 : 7.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**1 ∶ 4 ⇒ 1u + 4u = 5u 3 ∶ 7 ⇒ 3u + 7u = 10u 2 ∶ 3 ⇒ 2u + 3u = 5u All the containers of equal quantity LCM(5, 10, 5) = 10 (1 ∶ 4) × 2 = 5u × 2 ⇒ 2 : 8 (3 ∶ 7) × 1 = 10u × 1 ⇒ 3 : 7 (2 ∶ 3) × 2 = 5u × 2 ⇒ 4 : 6 Take addition of acid and water (2 + 3 + 4) : (8 + 7 + 6) 9 : 21 = 3 : 7 a3:Tcc4,
